Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government digital payment systems.  21 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: Algeria has national digital payment rails (interbank switch/SATM and mobile interoperability) and is launching/expanding instant payments: reports cite the launch of the mobile interoperability platform “Switch Mobile” (June 2024) and that the Bank of Algeria is preparing an “instant electronic payment system” enabling real-time settlement for merchants (announced Oct 2024).
